title: Austin's Judge Appointments Stalled
summary:
*   City officials met to discuss appointments for Municipal Court relief judges.
*   Concerns were raised about the limited pool of candidates proposed for judicial positions.
*   Following discussion, no action was taken on any of the proposed judge appointments.
